<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:camunda="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/bpmn" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="KYCOnboarding" name="KYC Customer Onboarding" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Onboarding Started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="uploadDocument" name="Upload Identity Document">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="verifyDocument" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="io.camunda:http-json:1" name="Verify Document via OCR">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="documentQuality" name="Document Verified?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="sanctionsScreening" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="io.camunda:http-json:1" name="Sanctions & PEP Screening">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="riskRouting" name="Risk Level?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="standardDueDiligence" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="io.camunda:http-json:1" name="Standard Due Diligence">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="enhancedDueDiligence" name="Enhanced Due Diligence Review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="finalRiskClassification" name="Final Risk Classification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:businessRuleTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="classificationGateway" name="Classification Outcome?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="notifyRejection" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="email-sender" name="Notify Rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="notifyApproval" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="email-sender" name="Notify Approval">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_compact_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endApproved" name="Customer Approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_16</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endRejected" name="Customer Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_17</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endEscalated" name="Escalated to Compliance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_compact_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="uploadDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_2" sourceRef="uploadDocument" targetRef="verifyDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_3" sourceRef="verifyDocument" targetRef="documentQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_4" sourceRef="documentQuality" targetRef="uploadDocument" name="verification-failed-retry">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>=ocrResponse.verified = false and (uploadRetries != null and uploadRetries < 2)</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_5" sourceRef="documentQuality" targetRef="notifyRejection" name="verification-failed-exhausted">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>=ocrResponse.verified = false and (uploadRetries = null or uploadRetries >= 2)</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_6" sourceRef="documentQuality" targetRef="sanctionsScreening" name="verification-passed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>=ocrResponse.verified = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_7" sourceRef="sanctionsScreening" targetRef="riskRouting"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_8" sourceRef="riskRouting" targetRef="standardDueDiligence" name="standard-risk">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>=screeningResponse.riskLevel = "low"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_9" sourceRef="riskRouting" targetRef="enhancedDueDiligence" name="enhanced-risk">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>=screeningResponse.riskLevel = "high" or screeningResponse.pepMatch = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_10" sourceRef="standardDueDiligence" targetRef="finalRiskClassification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_11" sourceRef="enhancedDueDiligence" targetRef="finalRiskClassification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_12" sourceRef="finalRiskClassification" targetRef="classificationGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_13" sourceRef="classificationGateway" targetRef="notifyApproval" name="approved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>=riskClassification.outcome = "approved"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_14" sourceRef="classificationGateway" targetRef="notifyRejection" name="rejected">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>=riskClassification.outcome = "rejected"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_15" sourceRef="classificationGateway" targetRef="endEscalated" name="escalate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>=riskClassification.outcome = "escalate"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_16" sourceRef="notifyApproval" targetRef="endApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_compact_17" sourceRef="notifyRejection" targetRef="endRejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
